products.model: RBC40D1S-AU · 12V 40A DC-DC Battery Charger with MPPT
products.notes: 40 A maximum battery output. Solar/DC input selection, approximated here as solar priority. MPPT input limits and charge taper are not validated. Converter efficiency is not deducted again from rated output.
products.basis: Maximum charger output current; not a consuming appliance

products.notes: 200 W STC; Vmp 19.2 V. Solar yield and controller limits are applied by the planner. Not a wiring compatibility check.
products.basis: STC panel output; voltage is Vmp, not battery voltage

products.notes: Manufacturer specifies variable 0.5–3.6 A and 12/24 V DC, without separate current figures for each voltage. The prefill uses 3.6 A × nominal 12 V = 43.2 W as a conservative planning conversion. Confirm voltage and measured draw. 45% duty is an estimate; daily Wh and startup power are unverified.
products.basis: Variable current 0.5–3.6 A; converted upper bound, not verified average watts

products.notes: 25 A total rated battery charging output. Generic combined-current limit approximates the controller; actual source allocation is not modelled.
12 V output system, 30 A rated charger output. Existing independent MPPT solar settings are preserved. Rated output does not need another converter-efficiency deduction.
15 A battery-side output; mains or generator supplies the charger. Runtime remains user-entered.
products.basis: Rated 12 V / 15 A battery charger output

products.notes: HW15 manual: 450 W continuous at 25°C; 380 W at 40°C; peak 750 W for 3 seconds. 86% is maximum efficiency, not a guaranteed load efficiency. Inverter output capacity is not continuous battery consumption. Idle is applied once while an AC appliance is scheduled.
110 W under STC. Bifacial/nameplate alternatives are not added. Solar yield is applied separately.
Legacy phased-out product retained for existing owners. STC rating is not daily harvest.
Average consumption range 25–40 W. The prefill uses the upper end of that average range, not a startup rating. Enter actual hours and account for any external power conversion separately.
products.basis: Manufacturer average-use range: 25–40 W; upper end prefilled

products.notes: Manufacturer lists 2 × 3 W LEDs. This is not verified USB charging input or vehicle-battery consumption. Enter measured charging watts and hours; no consumption value is invented.
products.basis: 2 × 3 W LED output only; external charging draw unverified

products.notes: Manufacturer documentation includes an annual energy label; it is not used as a camping daily estimate without matched test conditions. Enter measured watts/duty cycle or measured daily Wh. Startup power is unverified.
products.basis: Model verified; usable camping draw requires manual input
